name: UNR High School Dual Enrollment
what_you_do: Take college classes at the University of Nevada, Reno. Classes can count for high school credit and college credit. You can take up to 8 credits each semester.
who_can_apply: Nevada high school students who meet each course's prerequisites. A counselor or vice principal must back you. That lets the classes count toward graduation.
pay_detail: $154 per credit for tuition plus an $18 per credit tech fee, plus any class fees.
deadline_text: No deadline is stated on the program page.
how_to_apply: Fill out the UNR non-degree student application and the dual enrollment interest form. Send your shot records through the online portal (2 MMR doses and 1 Tdap). Upload your high school transcripts with the Transcript Upload form. Your counselor or vice principal fills out the school district contract form. They email it to DualEnrollment@unr.edu.
notes: Earlier college work can place you into classes. So can SAT or ACT scores, AP or IB scores, or placement tests.
